g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class A2 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 5.2 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - service (sour/HIC) 595-650 C. NDE: 20 % RT of BW; HB <= 200.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Pump suction: no pockets, header falls to pumps; eccentric reducers 10"x8" FLAT ON TOP; temporary straine
7. Pump nozzle 8" assumed (API 610 vendor data pending).
8. Vortex breaker in D-102 outlet nozzle (by vessel).
9. Common header, equal branch to each pump.
ISOMETRIC VIEW - NOT TO SCALE - DIMENSIONS IN mm, ELEVATIONS / COORDINATES IN m (PLANT GRID)
